hook: Sanju Samson made 4 off 10 today. After 10 balls, his typical innings costs India 7 runs. Abhishek's adds 3.
lines: Ishan adds one. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi breaks about even.
The case for Sanju: 97, 89 and 89 in his last three World Cup innings. India won all three.
But since the final, he's 25 runs above par per 100 balls. Vaibhav is 60.
And his batting has taken 44 percentage points off India's win chances. Vaibhav's has added 40.
